operating_conditions.label: Benign
operating_conditions.description: Deterministic, favorable ingredient prices with no delivery loss and no spoilage.
operating_conditions.prompt_text: ENVIRONMENT CONDITIONS: (a) Prices: ingredient prices are fixed in every production round — Mozzarella $1/unit, Basil $1/unit, Tomato $2/unit. (b) Delivery loss: there is no delivery loss; for each ingredient, if you order x units you receive x units. You pay for the full amount ordered. For example, ordering 6 Mozzarella means you pay for 6 and receive 6. (c) Spoilage: inventory carried over from the previous production round loses 0 units per ingredient per production round. (d) Inventory cap: you can store at most 10 units of each ingredient. Any received units that would exceed this cap are lost — you still pay for them. This cap applies before production, so you cannot order beyond capacity to use the surplus in the same round. Maximum order: 12 units of each ingredient per production round.
operating_conditions.prompt_production_process_negotiation: PRODUCTION WEEK PROCESS (in order): (1) no inventory spoilage occurs, (2) you order ingredients (there is no delivery loss), (3) you produce dishes and deliver them, (4) prices remain fixed for the next production round.
operating_conditions.prompt_production_process_performance: PRODUCTION WEEK PROCESS (in order): (1) no inventory spoilage occurs, (2) you order ingredients (there is no delivery loss), (3) you produce dishes and deliver them, (4) prices remain fixed for the next production round.

customer_preference.label: Current
customer_preference.description: The current workshopped ContractBench customer private values.
customer_preference.prompt_private_values_negotiation: PRIVATE VALUATION: You privately value each Margherita Pizza at $12, each Pesto Pasta at $6, and each Tomato Soup at $3. These are your maximum per-unit valuations. You are willing to pay up to these amounts for each dish, but you prefer to save money.
customer_preference.prompt_private_values_performance: PRIVATE VALUATION: You privately value each Margherita Pizza at $12, each Pesto Pasta at $6, and each Tomato Soup at $3.
customer_preference.prompt_substitution: DISH SUBSTITUTABILITY: For any quantities ABOVE the minimum, dishes are substitutable at the rate: 1 Pizza = 2 Pastas = 4 Soups (equivalently, 1 Pasta = 2 Soups). For example, if you wanted 2 Pizzas but the caterer can only make the 1 minimum, the extra Pizza can be replaced by 2 Pastas or 4 Soups. The same logic applies to Pastas too.
